name: Running Man
note: Shuffle's running man is not hip-hop's: the slide is longer and the whole step stays lower. The two are separate steps with separate references, and reusing hip_hop's would be measuring one dance against another.

calibration.why: No reference has been harvested for this step, so every threshold below is UNSET rather than guessed. The step is DESCRIBED here — which phases it has, which quantity separates them, which joints do the work, what can go wrong. How much of each counts as right is a measurement, and measuring it is what the harvest is for.
calibration.unblockedBy: content/references/sh_running_man.json built from >=3 independent instructors (catalogue 6.0); the thresholds are then DERIVED from their disagreement, never authored

measurability.tierStatus: Awaiting reference harvest: no take of this step has been measured, so its detectability is unknown. Not a low tier — an unmeasured one.

scoring.freeJointsRationale: Arms in shuffle are personal and vary between scenes; nothing here is checked against a shape.

enter.valueStatus: unset until harvest — the metric is the observation, the number is the measurement

phases.note: One foot is flat and carrying the weight while the other knee is high. This is the shape a viewer reads as 'running'.

enter.valueStatus: unset until harvest — the metric is the observation, the number is the measurement

phases.note: The planted foot slides back as the lifted knee drops. The slide is what stops the dancer travelling, and it is the half most beginners leave out.

errors.severityStatus: unset until harvest — how BADLY this reads is a judgement about calibrated data
errors.note: The knee lifts but the other foot never slides back, so the dancer travels forward across the room instead of running on the spot.

reference.note: >=3 independent instructors required (catalogue 6.0). Tolerance is derived from their disagreement, never authored — which is why nothing here carries a number.
